item.title: Debugging Elisp
item.description: debug debug is a Lisp machine stack back-trace debugger. Usual workflow: Choose the way to initiate debugger. E.g. call debug-on-entry and choose a function. See bellow for other options. Do some operation that should eventually call the function. In the backtrace inspect the state, step through, look at locals, evaluate expressions etc. See bellow for useful shortcuts. Initiating debugger - useful shortcuts/functions debug-on-error - enters the debugger if an error is found.

item.title: Git tips
item.description: How to get the changes on a branch in Git # Changes on branch but not on HEAD (three dots) git diff HEAD...branch # List recent branches and switch $ git checkout $(git for-each-ref --sort='-authordate:iso8601' --format=' %(authordate:relative)%09%(refname:short)' refs | pick | cut -f2) # .gitconfig alias [alias] branches = "!sh -c \"git checkout $(git for-each-ref --sort='-authordate:iso8601' --format=' %(authordate:relative)%09%(refname:short)' refs | pick | cut -f2)\"" Source.
